headline: Clean: the knowledge base has no travel-notification procedure, so the right move is to say so and transfer with the 'search unsuccessful' code when the customer asks.
solution_check: A search of all 698 documents finds no procedure for setting a travel notification. Only passing mentions exist: gold_rewards_card_004 'Enable travel notifications if your risk controls require it.', diamond_elite_card_008 'Enable travel alerts...', and general_023 'Some cards have restrictions on international transactions that need to be lifted before traveling abroad.' The agent should admit it lacks the information. When the customer then asks for a human, 042 Tier 2 'kb_search_unsuccessful_customer_requests_transfer' fits, and no Tier-1 code applies. This matches the gold reason.
prior_note: Prior verdict was None; nothing relevant changed in v1.0.1.
notes: Risk: general_023 gives contact channels ('1-800-RHO-BANK', app chat, rhobank.com/help) for declined cards. An agent that relays them as the answer triggers the customer's rule 4 ('mentions specific forms or phone numbers, DO NOT ask for a transfer') and fails. Pointing a customer who is already talking to support back to the support line is a weak answer, so I do not count it as a defensible alternative. Grading model checked against snapshot fc0055d (tag v1.0.1): EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and compares get_db_hash/get_user_db_hash (both hash the one shared TransactionalDB); _derive_read_log_allowlist collects agent_tool_name from gold call_discoverable_agent_tool actions; call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool parse JSON with parse_int=float; apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float itself; Action.compare_with_tool_call matches by name plus compare_args (all agent-passed args when compare_args is None; always true when compare_args is []); get_now() is fixed at 2025-11-14 03:40:00 and get_current_time returns 'The current time is 2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST.'. Nuance: 'writes are logged even when the tool returns an error string' is only partly true. Many write paths return before touching the DB (apply_for_credit_card with an invalid card_type, call_discoverable_agent_tool on an unknown/not-unlocked tool or bad JSON, user discoverable tools not yet given).
